why: Widens the allowlist to arms the gallery cannot draw. 'turret' and 'smoke' are the sharp cases now: issues #526 and #536 retired both as cues because the gun recoil and the muzzle puff became unconditional, so accepting either would hand back a clip whose recoil or smoke has nothing to do with the flag that was passed -- and worse for 'smoke', the clip WOULD contain smoke, so the flag would look like it worked. 'hud' is a real cue the game renders, but into the DOM HUD no gallery page builds, and the audio and haptic arms have nothing to draw at all.
killedBy: gallery args takes a blocked-fire cue only for the moment that stages a refusal
